verdict.rationale: Reader's SaaS proxy claims to 'handle common anti-bot challenges automatically' and supports forwarding session cookies via X-Set-Cookie for login-walled pages, but neither is documented as solving CAPTCHAs, and cookie-based login still requires the user to manually obtain and supply valid session cookies beforehand. Missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA-solving capability, fully automatic login/form-wall traversal without any pre-supplied credentials, and independent evidence confirming these anti-bot claims work in practice.
